title: Import, export and back up
p: Your notes should never be locked inside an app. Edit Markdown files where they are, import Markdown or Feishu DocxXML, export a page as PDF or Markdown, and back up your documents as an ordinary folder.
Choose the import command in the File menu, or press ⌘ ⇧ I. Select one or more files. Each file becomes a new document; the last imported one opens when the import finishes.

td.p: Stays a Markdown file in your documents folder. Headings, lists, tasks, code, quotes, tables, links and images become editable blocks.
Text is imported with Markdown input supported by the importer.
Supported rich text, callouts, columns, tables and inline objects are preserved.

ul.li: The filename supplies the document title.
Local Markdown images referenced by relative or file URLs are copied into your documents folder.
An unreadable or unsupported file produces an import error; existing notes are not replaced.

callout.p: You can also paste into an existing page. Structured content preserves supported formatting; Markdown text is converted. Use ⌘ ⇧ V for plain text.

p: Choose Import Folder in the File menu. The folder appears in the sidebar with its subfolders inside it; the Markdown and DocxXML files in them become documents, in name order. Hidden folders and node_modules are skipped, and the original folder is not changed.
To edit a Markdown file where it is, without importing it, see Markdown in Quiet.md.
Open the document's More menu or right-click its sidebar entry and choose a download format.
PDF export lays out the page for A4 paper and preserves document styling, images and tables. Use it for sharing a read-only copy or checking a print layout.
The two ways to export Markdown, and how rich layouts are written in it, are in Markdown in Quiet.md.
Use the print command from the document menu to open the system print dialog. Choose a printer there, or save a PDF.

The default location is ~/Documents/Quiet Notes (a library from an earlier version stays in ~/Documents/Quiet.md); you can choose another the first time Quiet.md opens. Settings › Documents shows where it is. It is an ordinary folder, and what you see in the Finder is what the sidebar shows. To work on another folder as well, click Add Folder at the top of the sidebar (or press ⌘ ⇧ O) and choose it; the window that asks can make a new one too. It shows in the sidebar beside this one, and its files stay where they are.

pre.caption: ~/Documents/Quiet.md
pre.code: Quiet.md/ ├── Work/ A folder in the sidebar is a folder here │ ├── Weekly.xml One file per document, named after its title │ └── Plan.md Markdown documents stay Markdown ├── Ideas.xml ├── .assets/ Images and attachments (hidden) └── .quiet/ Quiet.md's own data (hidden) ├── meta/ Pins, order and dates, a folder per device ├── trash/ Deleted documents ├── history/ Earlier versions of each document ├── themes/ Custom CSS themes └── preferences.json, shortcuts.json

p: Document files use DocxXML, or Markdown for Markdown documents. Links between documents are written as relative paths, so a copy of the whole folder keeps them working. You can read the files with any editor; quit Quiet.md before changing them outside the app.

A library from an earlier version moves to this layout the first time it opens. If it is in a synced folder such as iCloud Drive or Dropbox, Quiet.md asks first, because another computer may still run an older version. The old layout is kept in .quiet for 30 days.

ul.li: Autosave: edits are written after a short pause. A temporary file is written before replacing the document.
Visible errors: failed saves remain marked as unsaved. Before switching documents or quitting, the app asks how to handle them.
Metadata backup: each file in .quiet/meta/ keeps a .bak copy, which helps recover one that cannot be read.

Version history: the ⋯ menu opens a drawer of the document's earlier versions, newest first and grouped by day. Pick one and the note shows that version in place, read-only, with the blocks it added or rewrote tinted; Esc goes back to the current text. Name a version to find it again, restore it, or save it as a copy. The number kept is set in Settings › Documents.

Multiple windows: windows in the same app process share changes. Independent instances check the saved document against the version they opened. A conflicting save is rejected instead of overwriting newer content; export your unsaved work before reopening.

p: Include the entire documents folder, hidden folders too, not just the document files. Time Machine can protect it if the Documents folder is included in your backup. For a manual archive, quit Quiet.md and run:
A sync service is not a substitute for a backup. Avoid editing the same synced documents on two computers at once; local file locking does not coordinate separate machines.

ol.li: Quit Quiet.md on the old Mac with ⌘ Q.
Copy the complete documents folder into Documents on the new Mac.
Open Quiet.md there. The folder includes your documents, hierarchy, themes and shortcuts.

callout.p: Markdown and DocxXML files you put into the folder in the Finder show up as documents too. Keep a backup before adding many files this way.
